description: Agent processing may improve vault quality while atrophying human knowledge-work and meta-cognitive skills.
warning: "To fully automate [metadata creation] is to outsource the very cognitive process that PKM seeks to enhance."
Full delegation hides comprehension debt (Collector’s Fallacy inversion), bypasses the generation effect, and decouples the Extended Mind.
Question: Is approving agent work sufficient cognitive engagement to preserve capability?
Warning sign: inability to imagine working without the agent.
Mitigation: human-in-the-loop synthesis, periodic manual mode, and focused tend/prune/fertilize approvals to prevent rubber-stamping.
Related: [[does agent processing recover what fast capture loses]], [[productivity porn risk in meta-system building]], [[verbatim risk applies to agents too]].
